description: NoteCove is a local-first notes and task management app built for people who are serious about their data and want AI working alongside them — not gatekeeping their content on some company’s servers. At its core, NoteCove is a rich-text editor paired with a full task manager: folders, tags, inter-note links, Kanban boards, comments with emoji reactions, revision history with word-level diffs, and full-text search — all stored locally on your device.
